name: wait_four_vertical_blanks
description: Calls the graphics library's WaitTOF routine four times in a loop, pausing until four vertical-blank frames have passed.

name: run_clamped_frame_sequence
description: Runs a fixed series of helper calls and two counted loops that step bounded 16-bit counters, clamping them at zero, 200 and 199. It then fills a table with minus one, polls a check over 200 entries, and sets two state words to 160 and 100 and clears two others on both exit paths.

name: initialise_fixed_point_matrices
description: Stores 16384, the fixed-point value of one, and zeros into several groups of 16-bit fields, leaving them in an identity-like state. The routine contains only these constant stores and no comparisons.

name: transform_pair_and_commit
description: Stores two input components, multiplies them through a fixed-point coefficient table with a scale-by-four and high-word shift to produce six result words, then copies nine words of the result into the working block.

name: transform_pair_negated_and_commit
description: Computes six fixed-point products from two inputs, negating the first input for part of them, against a coefficient table. It writes the results into a block and copies nine words of it into the working block.

name: compose_transform_with_differences
description: Computes three fixed-point differences and three sums of two inputs against coefficient fields, copies three constant fields into the output, and copies nine words of the result into the working block.

name: test_four_plane_separations
description: Tests the state position against up to four entries of a fixed-stride table and keeps the smallest separation. When every entry exceeds the 99 margin it stores a scaled value and returns a failure code; otherwise it returns the chosen index and a projected value from a second coefficient set.

name: compute_normalised_offset_vector
description: Initialises a block of state words, then computes three difference components between a stored position and an input position, normalises them by a magnitude returned from a helper, and scales the result by a stored gain. It then adds a second correction built from averaged table entries to the three output fields.

name: find_first_plane_within_margin
description: Tests a position against up to four entries of a fixed-stride table and returns the index of the first entry whose separation is 99 or less. If all four exceed that margin it returns a failure code, and it also flags a large negative final separation.

name: repeat_helper_until_limit
description: When three state flags have one particular combination, it sets a limit and repeats a helper call until a counter falls below its base value or a state word changes, using a different loop when a signed value is positive. It then clears one state flag and sets another to minus one when that value is nonzero.

name: initialise_global_state_words
description: Clears a 175-entry word table and many state words, fills 40 coefficient entries using helper calls, and sets fixed starting values such as 160 and 100 and the limits 12000 and 9000. It ends with helper calls and a flag-dependent branch, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: initialise_state_block_fields
description: Performs the same initialisation as its global-address counterpart but through a state-block base pointer: it clears word tables, fills 40 coefficient entries through helper calls and sets starting values such as 160 and 100. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through, so the final branches are not visible.

name: stage_global_and_run_helpers
description: Stores a 32-bit state field into a global and calls a helper, then reassigns the global from a second value and makes seven further helper calls.

name: latch_value_after_helper_steps
description: Makes seven helper calls, stores a 32-bit global value into a state field, then makes two more helper calls.

name: wrap_phase_and_derive_offsets
description: Reads a global step value and adds it to a table entry selected by a state index, subtracting the stored limit once if the sum reaches it. It then derives several scaled fields from the result, the limit and the step.

name: select_colour_set_by_sign
description: Chooses one of two fixed sets of four 16-bit words according to the sign of a state word, writes it into a table at offsets 2 to 8, and sets three counters to 12 or 3 to match.

name: run_helpers_with_swapped_pointer
description: When a state word is negative, it saves two context pointers, temporarily swaps in another pointer, and runs a short sequence of helper calls with fixed arguments. It then restores the saved pointers.

name: clear_text_slots_reset_timer
description: Blanks six text character positions with spaces and increments a counter. It then sets several state fields to minus one, 500 and zero, and sets a 32-bit timer-like field to a base value plus 180000.

name: populate_record_table_entries
description: Resets several state fields, then walks a fixed run of table entries and fills each record with a sequence index, a byte-table value clamped at zero, a helper result plus a constant, and a large sentinel limit.

name: refresh_entry_records_in_place
description: Walks the same chain of records as its sibling routine and updates each one in place: it sets a sequence index, recomputes a difference from a byte table with a stored offset added when negative, resets counters, and sets a large sentinel limit.

name: dispatch_character_command_loop
description: Runs a loop that calls helpers for timing and state, then reads a character code from a helper and dispatches on it through a chain of comparisons, updating counters and flags in each case. One branch sets a delay from a state counter, capped at 6000.

name: fill_result_text_rows
description: Resets input and state words, then copies ten-byte entries from a linked list into text buffers, padding unused positions with spaces up to 29 columns. It then runs a counted loop of 18 or 36 frames that calls helpers and advances a counter, and finishes with timing and helper calls.

name: update_best_record_for_slot
description: Scans a linked list of records for the one with the smallest 32-bit value field. If that value beats the best stored for the current slot, it saves it, copies ten bytes from a ten-byte-per-entry table into the slot's block, and sets a flag to minus one.

name: store_selected_slot_best
description: Uses the record already selected in the state block. If its 32-bit value beats the best stored for the current slot, it saves that value, copies ten bytes from a ten-byte-per-entry table into the slot's block, and sets a flag to minus one.

name: stub_empty_decompiled_body
description: The decompiler produced only an empty return for this 126-instruction routine, so it is a stub or bad data and no behaviour can be recovered from the pseudo-code.

name: dispatch_one_of_two_triples
description: When two state words are both zero, it runs one of two groups of three helper calls, chosen by a third state word. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: run_two_helpers_when_idle
description: Makes two helper calls only when four state words are all zero, and otherwise returns without doing anything.

name: advance_timer_by_fifteen
description: Makes two helper calls and then adds 15 to a 32-bit counter in the state block. The decompiled body is short, so the remaining instructions are not visible in the pseudo-code.

name: copy_record_words_to_row
description: Walks the linked record list for up to six entries, copying each record's leading word into a row of an 18-byte-per-row table selected by a state index. It adds a companion global word into a field of each record, then increments the state index.

name: run_timed_key_dispatch_loop
description: Runs a loop similar to its sibling command loop: it calls helpers for timing and state, reads a character code and dispatches on it through comparisons, with some cases gated by a control word. It updates counters and flags in each case.

name: update_motion_from_control_flags
description: Adjusts a motion state from a set of control flag bits, adding helper results scaled by shifts for each axis, and wraps a heading value by 360 units. It then copies nine words into a saved block and updates a derived position and counters.

name: advance_position_from_saved_state
description: Applies the stored velocity and a table-driven term to the position and heading fields, wrapping the heading within 360 units. It compares a derived value with a threshold, and when the threshold is passed it copies nine words into a saved block and updates a flag and counter.

name: advance_position_from_register_inputs
description: Takes the heading and position inputs from registers rather than the state block, then applies the same velocity, table term and threshold steps as its sibling routine.

name: advance_position_wrap_negative_heading
description: Takes heading and position inputs from registers, wraps only a negative heading by 360 units, and then applies the same velocity, table-term and threshold steps as its sibling routines.

name: update_speed_and_audio_volumes
description: Sets two audio channel volume registers to 40 or 60 depending on a flag, then adjusts a speed value by a step derived from a stored field and a target, with the direction chosen from a flag bit.

name: set_audio_periods_from_speed
description: Derives a target value from a speed field and a table byte, clamps it between 299 and 810, and writes it to two audio period registers. It then updates a timer-like field and calls helpers when a counter runs out.

name: adjust_velocity_fields_from_flags
description: Adjusts two velocity fields from a control flag byte: one changes by a damped or accelerated step, and the other is nudged by a term based on its own magnitude. A mode field records which branch ran, and when the high control bit is set the routine only records a mode flag.

name: read_joystick_direction_bits
description: Decodes the joystick port movement word into a bitmask with one bit per direction, adds a fire-button bit when that input is idle, and stores the mask in a state byte.

name: update_linked_entries_with_limits
description: Sets two 32000 limit fields and a flag, then walks linked entries and updates each entry's position fields from a scaled value, calling helpers and branching on state words. The referenced text suggests a numeric display is involved.

name: step_third_audio_channel_sequence
description: Steps through a sequence of entries spaced 95 bytes apart. When a countdown expires it writes the third audio channel's period and volume from a clamped difference, and it calls one helper. The decompiled body is partly unreached code, so only its main path is described.

name: update_entry_timer_mark_bit
description: Returns zero when a recorded time is less than 400 units old. Otherwise it advances an entry's counter, sets that entry's bit in a state mask, and resets several fields when the counter is positive, calling helpers when a comparison passes.

name: update_motion_offsets_and_limits
description: Makes helper calls gated by several state flags, then reduces a counter by a velocity-derived amount with a minimum of one. It adds stepped offsets into two fields, clamps the counter at zero, and checks a table value against a limit.

name: advance_state_machine_stage
description: Advances a stage counter when a countdown expires or a flag allows it, using timed wait loops and helper calls for each stage. It returns early while a gating flag is set and resets a control flag when a stage starts.

name: send_stage_commands_when_idle
description: Waits until a pending word is zero, then sends a command to a helper with the stage counter as its value. When the stage is zero it first sets a 32-bit field to 800 and sends a command with a fixed code.

name: toggle_position_indicator_flags
description: Toggles a flag for each of two offset fields as it moves into or out of the 180 to 224 window, and toggles another flag when a counter is positive and below 3751. It then runs conditional helper calls, checks a position entry against a stored value, and updates timing fields.

name: pass_register_pair_through
description: Calls one helper, then returns the two 32-bit input register values unchanged as a pair.

name: probe_fields_then_restore
description: Saves two 16-bit fields, calls helpers, and temporarily adds a helper result minus 24 to each field. It then restores the saved values, so the fields are left unchanged.

name: relay_helper_result_checked
description: Calls one helper and returns its result pair. When a flag is set and the returned high word is positive, it calls a second helper, choosing between two paths depending on whether that value is below 2.

name: start_counter_timer_when_idle
description: When a counter is zero, it sends a fixed code of 12 if a state word is positive, increments the counter, and sets a 32-bit timer to a base value plus 5000. It then calls a helper.

name: reset_countdown_state_from_table
description: Clears a timer field to minus one, resets two counters, and sets a counter to 15. It computes a deadline from a table entry and a helper result scaled by five and four, and sets a flag to minus one when a table byte is nonzero.

name: clear_countdown_and_deadlines
description: When a state word is positive it sends a fixed code of 13 through a helper. It then sets a counter to minus 15, two deadlines to minus one, and a flag to zero, calling two helpers.

name: refresh_display_wait_frame
description: Updates a timer-like field and clamps a derived value at 30000, then runs a frame update that calls the graphics library's view-loading, vertical-blank and blitter wait routines alongside helper calls and counter increments.

name: forward_stack_value_through_helper
description: Calls one helper and returns the 32-bit value that was on the stack at entry.

name: accumulate_point_differences_along_path
description: Clears three accumulator longwords, then walks three parallel coordinate arrays, storing each point, the differences from the previous point, and a helper result for each step.

name: compute_triangle_normal_vector
description: Computes two edge vectors from three coordinate triples, takes their cross product, divides each component by a value returned from a helper, and stores the three results.

name: compute_interpolation_step_deltas
description: Computes differences between consecutive values in three arrays and divides them by a step count derived from a helper result, writing per-step deltas for each array until the count is reached.

name: derive_speed_and_scaled_entries
description: Derives a speed value from a table entry and a stored field, falling back to 3000 when it is zero, and computes a scaled field from a distance divided by that speed. It then writes a clamped per-entry value into each entry of a record list.

name: restore_initial_state_from_tables
description: Sets a flag to minus one and clears a global. It copies three position values from a table into the state block, storing their negations alongside, and resets an index. It then copies saved coefficient blocks into state fields and writes the third audio channel's volume.

name: set_flag_after_helper_call
description: Calls one helper, then sets a state word to minus one.

name: restore_working_fields_from_saved
description: Clears two state words and copies saved fields back into the working fields. It then copies the working coefficient tables into global tables and back into the state block, calling four helpers along the way.

name: stub_empty_return
description: An empty routine that only returns; it contains no behaviour.

name: relay_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper and returns, with no other work.

name: stub_empty_decompiled_body
description: The decompiler produced only an empty return for this 64-instruction routine, so it is a stub or bad data and no behaviour can be recovered from the pseudo-code.

name: shift_history_table_entries
description: Shifts a table of two-longword entries down by one place, saving the first entry's two values at the end of the table. The number of entries comes from a state word minus one.

name: format_time_into_text_line
description: Writes the entry index as a digit, copies ten bytes of label text from a table, and formats a 32-bit time value as minutes, seconds and fractional digits separated by a colon and a point in a text buffer.

name: format_time_into_record_text
description: Copies ten bytes of label text from a table into a per-record text buffer, then formats a 32-bit time value as minutes, seconds and fractional digits, with a space before the label.

name: draw_glyph_into_bitplane
description: Calls helpers, then reads a character code and blits its glyph from a font table into a bitplane. Each row is shifted by a computed offset and OR-ed into the target words for each enabled plane mask.

name: write_marker_codes_for_count
description: Writes a marker code of 13 into up to four fixed positions, the number depending on a count word, and then sets one more position to 3.

name: copy_field_and_advance_offset
description: Copies one 16-bit state field into another and then adds six to a third state field.

name: emit_lap_time_rows_countdown
description: Calls helpers to prepare a time value from a 32-bit state field. When a count word is nonzero it loops from twelve downward, calling a helper for each step while the count decreases, and returns the time value.

name: format_six_digits_or_blank
description: If a 32-bit value is non-negative and below a fixed limit, it writes six digit characters built from stored digit bytes into a text buffer. Otherwise it fills those positions with spaces.

name: copy_ten_bytes_call_helper
description: Copies ten bytes from a source pointer into a fixed buffer and then calls one helper.

name: format_two_digit_field
description: Formats a value as two decimal digits, blanking a zero tens digit and taking the value modulo 100 when it exceeds 99. It then calls a helper and writes five digit characters taken from stored digit bytes.

name: split_time_into_digit_bytes
description: Halves a 32-bit time value, converts it into minutes, seconds and fractional digits, and stores each digit as a separate byte in global digit locations.

name: format_elapsed_time_codes
description: Returns early when one state word is zero and another is nonzero. Otherwise it writes four marker codes into fixed positions, then converts the elapsed time since a stored start value, halved, into digit bytes.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns; the routine body is a single return.

name: call_two_helpers_swapped_context
description: When one state word is nonzero or another is zero, it temporarily sets a longword context field to one fixed value and calls a helper, then sets it to a second fixed value and calls a helper again. It restores the original value afterwards.

name: format_remaining_count_field
description: Writes four marker codes into fixed positions, then derives a count from a limit minus a state word, or from the state word clamped at zero. It writes the count's two digits, with a blank in place of a zero tens digit.

name: write_numbered_entry_labels
description: Walks the linked entries and writes each entry's label bytes and a two-digit number, one more than its stored index, into consecutive text positions.

name: mark_entries_below_minimum_threshold
description: Finds the smallest 16-bit value among the linked entries, excluding one special entry. It then walks the entries again and marks those whose 32-bit field is unset or below a threshold derived from a table value, calling a helper at the end.

name: find_entry_write_label
description: Searches the linked entries for one whose key matches a value from an input pointer, returning minus one if none matches. When it finds one it writes the entry's index digit and label bytes into text, and fills a 32-bit field with a fixed filler pattern when that field is unset.

name: advance_entry_write_label
description: Advances a cyclic entry index, wrapping it when it reaches the entry count plus two, then finds the entry at that position and writes its index digit and label bytes into text. It returns minus one when that position is not found.

name: select_next_entry_when_idle
description: When two state words are both zero, it advances a target index to the following entry, wrapping at a stored limit. It copies that entry's field into a state word and sets two flags to minus one and zero.

name: write_signed_marker_time
description: When a state word is zero, writes a plus or minus marker chosen by the list index, then writes a label byte pair from a table. It converts a time value divided by 20 into digit characters, blanking leading zeros.

name: compare_adjacent_entry_positions
description: Walks consecutive pairs of linked entries while a state word is zero, combining each entry's position with a scaled offset and comparing the two. It then updates entry fields according to the result.

name: reset_entry_timers_and_offsets
description: Sets a timer from a base value when one state word is nonnegative. When another is nonnegative it clears two counters, calls a helper with a temporary index, and sets a deadline from a scaled difference of two state words. Otherwise it copies an entry's fields and calls helpers.

name: sort_entries_by_key_ascending
description: Repeatedly passes over the linked entries and moves each entry whose 32-bit key is lower than its predecessor's ahead of it, counting the moves. It returns the count in the result register.

name: find_nearest_table_index
description: Scans table entries indexed by a state position, computing a weighted sum from two coordinate fields and a third value. When a sum falls below a per-entry threshold it stores that index as the current index and updates related flags, calling six helpers along the way.

name: update_latch_on_deadline
description: Calls one helper when a deadline is negative and a set of flag words allow it, managing a latch word along the way. Some branches return early without calling the helper.

name: dispatch_helper_by_selection_index
description: Calls one of three helpers depending on whether a selection word equals three, equals one, or is neither.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper and returns.

name: record_value_and_advance_counter
description: Returns early while a flag or state word is set. Otherwise it stores a 32-bit value into a 100-entry table at the current counter, adds it to an accumulator, sets a flag bit, increments the counter, and then runs a helper loop.

name: run_guarded_state_update_sequence
description: Clears two state words and calls a helper, returning early when its result is negative or when the current index matches a stored one. Otherwise it runs a long sequence of conditional helper calls and state updates, and the referenced text includes a waiting prompt.

name: ease_position_toward_targets
description: Steps position fields toward input targets by one eighth of the difference on each of up to eight iterations, rewriting the negated positions each step. It copies a table block when a flag is set and stops early when a state word signals completion.

name: load_entry_position_reset
description: Loads position values from a table entry and stores their negations in a companion block, then clears a group of motion and counter fields. Otherwise it writes a fixed value to the audio volume registers, selects a table value by a state flag, and returns.

name: clear_motion_and_counter_fields
description: Clears twelve 16-bit state fields used for motion and counters.

name: probe_fields_half_offset
description: Saves two 16-bit fields, calls a helper, and temporarily adds a helper result minus half of an input value to each field. It calls two more helpers and then restores the saved values.

name: load_position_from_table_entry
description: Calls one helper, then loads three 16-bit values from tables indexed by the current index into the position fields, storing their negations alongside and clearing several counters.

name: step_scaled_position_copy
description: Runs an eight-step loop that scales a state word by one eighth, copies a block of nine words each step, and calls helpers. It clears two fields before the loop begins.

name: load_indexed_position_with_offset
description: Clears a state word, then loads three position values from tables indexed by the current index. It adds ten to one of them and calls several helpers to complete the setup.

name: tick_counter_and_run_helpers
description: Increments a 32-bit counter and calls a fixed group of helpers, with two of them gated by flag bits.

name: clear_pair_and_run_helpers
description: Calls three helpers, clears two 16-bit fields, and then calls five more helpers in sequence.

name: initialise_position_from_table
description: Loads position values from table entries for the current index and sets a fixed 16-bit position value. It also sets several flags to minus one, calling helpers around the setup.

name: start_sound_load_and_wait
description: Sets sound-loading state from a file path text, then calls helpers and polls one until it returns zero or 12000 ticks pass. It then enters an endless loop.

name: reset_state_wait_frame
description: Resets a set of state words to starting values, with one branch setting sound-related globals when a flag is set. It calls helpers around the resets, including the graphics library's vertical-blank wait.

name: run_three_helpers_blit_clear
description: Calls three routines in sequence, one of them a library wrapper that clears a blitter area.

name: advance_stage_at_threshold
description: Compares an accumulated value with a threshold and, when it passes, increments a stage counter. At stage four it sets a state word and calls helpers, and it enters an endless loop when a flag is set.

name: copy_block_with_scaled_ratio
description: Divides one input scaled by 4096 by the sum of two inputs, using ten when the sum is zero. It then copies a nine-word block and calls helpers.

name: increment_index_wrapping_at_limit
description: Returns the input index plus one, or zero when that value reaches a stored limit.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper and returns without other work.

name: call_two_helpers_then_return
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns.

name: compute_segment_offset_vector
description: Clears two state words, selects an index with wrap-around, and computes three coordinate differences between table entries for that index and the next. It normalises them with helper results and writes scaled values into state fields.

name: copy_block_with_negated_offset
description: Calls one helper, sets a field to the negation of another state word, copies a nine-word block, and clears a counter.

name: record_interval_and_running_minimum
description: Computes the interval since the last recorded time. When a state word is nonnegative it stores the interval and saves a counter, and it updates a running minimum when the interval is above 500 and below the current minimum. It returns the interval, or zero when the state word is negative.

name: call_two_helpers_swapped_context
description: When one state word is nonzero or another is zero, it temporarily sets a longword context field to one fixed value and calls a helper, then sets it to a second fixed value and calls a helper again. It restores the original value afterwards.

name: write_four_codes_call_helpers
description: Writes the four fixed values 15, 4, 18 and 12 into state fields, then calls two helpers.

name: call_context_helper_with_arguments
description: When two flags are clear, it temporarily swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with four arguments taken from a table indexed by a control word. It then swaps in a second context and calls another helper, restoring the originals afterwards.

name: relay_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns.

name: transform_points_by_matrix_rows
description: Walks a set of point arrays, adding offsets from a state table to each coordinate, and writes three fixed-point dot products per point using a 3-by-3 coefficient matrix into output arrays. It sets a few state fields and runs helper calls around the loop.

name: insert_entry_and_sort_bucket
description: Inserts an entry into the first free slot of a four-slot bucket chosen from a state value, then bubble-sorts that bucket by a 32-bit key stored in each entry.

name: shift_history_and_advance_offset
description: Subtracts 32 from a state word, shifts two stored pairs of words down by one slot, and calls one of two helpers depending on whether the low four bits of a control value are zero.

name: dispatch_by_low_control_bits
description: Calls one of two helpers depending on whether the low four bits of a control value are zero.

name: clamp_level_and_call_helpers
description: Returns early when a flag or state word is set. Otherwise it computes a scaled value offset by a constant and clamped to 127, stores it in a state field, and calls five helpers.

name: send_code_pair_type_one
description: When four state words meet their conditions, it temporarily swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with 285 and a packed constant. It then calls a second helper and restores the pointer.

name: send_code_pair_type_two
description: When four state words meet their conditions, it temporarily swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with 285 and a different packed constant. It then calls a second helper and restores the pointer.

name: send_code_pair_type_three
description: When four state words meet their conditions, it temporarily swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with 285 and a further packed constant. It then calls a second helper and restores the pointer.

name: send_code_pair_type_four
description: When four state words meet their conditions, it temporarily swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with 285 and another packed constant. It then calls a second helper and restores the pointer.

name: compute_channel_volume_from_table
description: Sets the fourth audio channel's volume from the difference of two inputs scaled by four and offset by 63. It then looks up a table entry for a channel index and derives related values from it.

name: toggle_marker_pair_values
description: When a flag is set, toggles a pair of words between zero and twelve in a table entry, setting three longwords to twelve or zero to match. Otherwise it works on the entry selected by a state offset.

name: repeat_helper_while_nonzero
description: Calls a helper and, while it returns a nonzero value, calls another helper and asks again.

name: initialise_small_state_table
description: Sets six state words to fixed starting values such as 20, 175, 53 and 74, and copies two of them into neighbouring fields.

name: reset_state_and_write_text
description: Resets many state and display words, sets a context pointer and several fields to fixed values including 30 and 254, then calls helpers and writes nine characters of text into a buffer.

name: reset_defaults_and_load_view
description: Resets a large set of state and display fields to defaults, including values such as 320 and 200, and sets up the context before calling helpers and the graphics library's view-loading routine. It also prepares text for the options artwork file, as its referenced text shows.

name: call_two_helpers_then_return
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns.

name: write_one_based_index_digit
description: Calls two helpers, then either calls a helper or writes a one-based index digit into a text position chosen from a stored offset, depending on a flag.

name: set_context_pair_call_helpers
description: Sets two context pointers and two longword fields to fixed values, calls five helpers, then resets them to other fixed values and calls one more helper when a state word is set.

name: reset_display_load_view
description: Sets two flags to minus one, clears a state word, and sets display counters to fixed values such as 200, 30 and 254. It calls the graphics library's view-loading routine and several helpers.

name: cycle_selection_index_with_helpers
description: Calls helpers in a loop until one returns zero, then runs a loop that advances a selection index, wrapping after four, whenever a helper returns one. It returns early on several state conditions.

name: run_counter_code_loop
description: Sets a counter to one, adds one if an input bit is set, and loops calling helpers. While a state word is positive it sends a code of 14 with the counter, repeatedly checking helper results and state flags.

name: set_context_call_sequence
description: Sets a longword field and a context pointer to fixed values, then calls six helpers in sequence.

name: compute_clamped_scaled_pair
description: Computes two scaled values from a table entry, clamping two inputs at 17 and scaling each by twice the table value divided by 35. It then derives a third field from another state word.

name: advance_mode_with_helpers
description: Selects between two branches on a mode word. One calls three helpers and sets a stage value to five, while the other records a mode flag and copies state fields before its helper calls.

name: sort_four_indices_by_key
description: Sets up a table of four index pairs and bubble-sorts them in repeated passes by a 16-bit key field, swapping neighbours into descending order.

name: write_four_entry_name_texts
description: Walks four indexed entries and, for each, copies a label of nine characters derived from a table into a text buffer, filling the entry's leading bytes from the table as well.

name: reset_flags_run_helper_loops
description: Clears a mode word and sets a counter to five, then runs an eight-iteration helper loop and a six-iteration loop that reads a helper result. Helper calls surround both loops.

name: call_helpers_stage_five
description: Calls helpers, with an extra helper call when a register value equals five, and then makes one more helper call.

name: set_fields_call_swapped
description: Sets four 16-bit fields to 1, 13, 10 and 113, then calls one helper under one swapped context and another helper under a second context, restoring the original afterwards.

name: call_helper_with_indexed_arguments
description: Calls a helper twice under one swapped context, passing the current index, six and 124 as arguments. It then calls two helpers under a second context before restoring the original.

name: pass_through_helper_call
description: Calls one helper and returns.

name: write_two_digit_text_glyph
description: Writes a two-digit decimal form of an input into two text bytes, then calls a helper and blits a character glyph from a font table into a bitplane. Each row is shifted by a computed offset and OR-ed into the target words for each enabled plane mask.

name: call_two_helpers_each_context
description: Swaps in one context pointer and calls two helpers, then swaps in a second and calls two more, restoring the original pointer afterwards.

name: call_single_helper_only
description: Calls one helper and returns.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper and returns without other work.

name: call_three_helpers_return_input
description: Calls three helpers in sequence and returns the 16-bit input value unchanged.

name: set_display_values_and_call
description: Sets eight state fields to fixed values, including 166, 172, 52 and 90, then calls two helpers and returns the 16-bit input value unchanged.

name: set_alternate_values_and_call
description: Sets eight state fields to a second group of fixed values, including 109, 115, 52 and 90, then calls two helpers and returns the 16-bit input value unchanged.

name: wait_timeout_or_state_change
description: Runs nested loops that call helpers and the graphics library's bottom-of-view wait. It leaves the loops when a timer difference passes 17999 units or a state condition changes.

name: return_failure_code
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else.

name: read_digit_code_reset_state
description: Reads a character code from a helper and stores it as a numeric digit in a state word. It then resets a set of flags and state words and calls helpers.

name: clear_flag_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers, then clears a state word to zero.

name: set_flag_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers, then sets a state word to minus one.

name: run_frame_code_dispatch
description: Runs a loop that waits for the graphics library's bottom-of-view and calls helpers. It dispatches on a state code of fourteen or seven through conditional branches, updating counters and flags in each case.

name: read_menu_key_selection
description: Reads a character from a helper and returns minus one when it is Q or lower-case q. Otherwise, when the character is a digit under twelve, it stores that digit as a selection index.

name: return_failure_code
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else.

name: call_indexed_helper_first_table
description: When a flag for the input index is nonnegative, it swaps in a fixed context and calls a helper with two arguments looked up from a table by that index. It then restores the context and calls one more helper.

name: call_indexed_helper_second_table
description: When a flag for the input index is nonnegative, it swaps in a fixed context and calls a helper with two arguments looked up from a second table by that index. It restores the context afterwards.

name: call_indexed_helper_when_enabled
description: When a flag for the input index is nonnegative, it looks up two values for that index and calls a helper under a swapped context. It then calls another helper.

name: call_indexed_helper_second_table
description: When a flag for the input index is nonnegative, it swaps in a fixed context and calls a helper with two arguments read from a second table by that index. It restores the context afterwards.

name: call_helper_each_index_down
description: Calls one helper for each value from the input down to zero inclusive, counting down by one.

name: format_elapsed_time_text
description: Converts the time since a stored start value, halved, into minutes, seconds and fractional digits, and writes them as text bytes separated by a colon and a point.

name: set_fields_call_when_flagged
description: When one flag is clear and another is set, it clears that second flag, sets four fields to fixed values including 12, 161, 14 and 190, and calls two helpers under a swapped context.

name: set_fields_call_swapped
description: Sets four fields to 12, 161, 14 and 190, then calls one helper under a swapped context and another helper under a second context.

name: start_timed_frame_update
description: When several flags are clear, copies a counter into a 32-bit field and sets a flag to minus one. It adds 15 to that field when another flag is clear, then calls helpers and waits for the graphics library's vertical-blank routine.

name: set_entry_values_call_helpers
description: When a flag is clear, sets eight fixed values including 43, 72, 52 and 64 and calls two helpers. It also waits for the graphics library's vertical-blank routine.

name: draw_wrapped_text_string
description: Draws a text string with word wrapping: it reads characters up to a terminator byte or a carriage return, converts lower-case letters to upper case, and calls a glyph helper for each one. It breaks lines at spaces when the horizontal position passes a limit and advances the line by six units at each break.

name: set_text_box_draw_wrapped
description: Sets four box-geometry words from the text position and width, then calls one helper before drawing the text string with the same word-wrapping logic.

name: draw_wrapped_text_at_origin
description: Draws a wrapped text string starting from the origin stored in state words, using the same word-wrapping and upper-casing as its sibling text routines.

name: clear_buffer_and_format_numbers
description: Clears a sixteen-byte text buffer to spaces, then writes decimal characters derived from two input values into it, calling helpers before and after the formatting.

name: load_artwork_and_sound_files
description: Returns early when a state word is set. Otherwise it loads artwork and a sound file by path text, sets two audio channel volumes, and waits for the graphics library's vertical-blank routine between helper calls.

name: read_text_line_into_buffer
description: Blanks a sixteen-character buffer, then reads characters from a helper into it, converting lower-case letters to upper case. Backspace moves the cursor back, and a carriage return ends the input by writing a zero byte.

name: run_main_update_frame
description: Runs one update pass that checks several state flags, calls a long sequence of helpers, and updates counters, writing a status text when a check passes. The body makes more than twenty calls, so only its overall pattern is described.

name: run_main_loop_iteration
description: Increments a 32-bit counter and, on every eighth tick, runs a group of helper checks gated by state flags. It then continues with a long series of state updates and helper calls. The decompiled body is long, so only its overall pattern is described.

name: set_timer_plus_thirty
description: When two state words are clear, sets a context pointer to a fixed global and sets a 32-bit timer to the tick counter plus 30.

name: set_timer_plus_forty_five
description: Calls one helper, sets a context pointer to a fixed global, and sets a 32-bit timer to the tick counter plus 45.

name: call_helpers_on_flag_branch
description: When two flags are clear, swaps in a fixed context and calls helpers on one of two branches chosen by a third flag, then restores the context.

name: toggle_flag_and_reset_fields
description: When a state word is zero, toggles a flag word. When the result is nonzero, it clears two fields, halves a counter, sets a context pointer and a timer, and calls a helper.

name: double_counter_and_set_timer
description: Doubles a state counter, sets a context pointer to a fixed global, and sets a 32-bit timer to the tick counter plus 30.

name: call_seventeen_helpers_in_sequence
description: Makes seventeen consecutive helper calls with no other work.

name: wait_for_flag_then_call
description: When a helper returns nonzero, calls one helper, waits until a global word becomes zero, then calls another helper.

name: relay_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns.

name: call_helpers_with_table_arguments
description: Calls four helpers using input register values and a table value as arguments, then returns a 32-bit result built from them.

name: select_entry_by_mode
description: Chooses between two table-derived values based on a mode word and a state field, then calls two helpers with the chosen value.

name: initialise_coordinate_tables
description: Writes fixed 16-bit coordinate pairs into two tables, one pair per longword, to set their starting contents.

name: call_helper_fifteen_step_loop
description: Sets two state words from a table and a constant, then loops fifteen times calling a helper with a fixed first argument of 160 and table values for each step.

name: pulse_flag_over_steps
description: When a flag is set, runs a 26-step loop that calls two helpers each step. Every fourth tick it calls a helper that flips the sign of the flag when that helper returns zero.

name: call_helper_when_flag_set
description: Calls one helper when a flag word is nonzero, and otherwise returns.

name: run_fifty_five_step_loop
description: Sets a 16-bit field from a table value and a constant, then runs a loop of fifty-five steps, calling three helpers per step.

name: call_helpers_across_table_entries
description: Loops seventeen times over a table, calling a helper with a fixed first argument of 160 and each table value when a flag is set. It calls two helpers on every step.

name: update_audio_channels_two_three
description: Runs a long routine that sets audio channel periods and volumes for channels two and three from table values indexed by an input value. It has several conditional branches and helper calls.

name: pass_register_pair_optional
description: When a state word is nonzero, calls one helper. In either case it returns the 64-bit input register pair unchanged.
